spell.martial_spells.guardians_cry.guide: Forces nearby hostile creatures to target the caster for a short duration.
Become the defensive center of your allies, gaining temporary health and defenses while assuming part of their incoming damage.
Forms a defensive covenant with nearby allies. The caster gains absorption, armor, and armor toughness while a portion of damage received by protected allies is redirected to the caster.
